name: svg-french-press-nemotron-3.5-super-vl-s2-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg width="900" height="700" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <style>
      .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 20; font-weight: bold; fill: #1a1a1a; text-anchor: middle; }
      .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14; font-weight: bold; fill: #1a1a1a; text-anchor: middle; }
      .label-small { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12; fill: #1a1a1a; }
      .glass { fill: #cce6ff; stroke: #0d47a1; stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.85; }
      .glass-edge { fill: none; stroke: #0d47a1; stroke-width: 2; }
      .metal { fill: #d7ccc8; stroke: #5d4037; stroke-width: 2; }
      .metal-dark { fill: #b0a090; stroke: #5d4037; stroke-width: 2; }
      .plastic { fill: #efebe9; stroke: #4e342e; stroke-width: 2; }
      .rod { fill: none; stroke: #5d4037; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .mesh { fill: none; stroke: #777; stroke-width: 1; opacity: 0.7; }
      .leader { stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 5,4; }
      .box { fill: #fafafa; stroke: #999; stroke-width: 1; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <text x="450" y="28" class="title">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>

  <!-- ============ CARAFE (left, assembled) ============ -->
  <g id="carafe" transform="translate(140, 150)">
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="300" rx="82" ry="11" class="glass"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="300" rx="82" ry="11" class="glass-edge"/>
    <path d="M -82 10 L -82 290 L 82 290 L 82 10 Z" class="glass"/>
    <path d="M -82 10 L -82 290" class="glass-edge"/>
    <path d="M 82 10 L 82 290" class="glass-edge"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="10" rx="84" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="10" rx="84" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M 82 90 Q 140 90 140 180 L 112 180 Q 82 180 82 90 Z" class="glass"/>
    <path d="M 82 90 Q 140 90 140 180 L 112 180 Q 82 180 82 90 Z" class="glass-edge"/>
  </g>

  <text x="140" y="470" class="label">1. Carafe (glass beaker)</text>
  <text x="140" y="488" class="label-small" text-anchor="middle">(shown assembled, for reference)</text>

  <!-- ============ EXPLODED PLUNGER (right) ============ -->
  <line x1="640" y1="130" x2="640" y2="620" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>

  <circle cx="640" cy="100" r="13" class="plastic"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="100" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#4e342e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="742" y="104" class="label-small">Knob</text>
  <line x1="658" y1="100" x2="732" y2="104" class="leader"/>

  <ellipse cx="640" cy="180" rx="72" ry="17" class="plastic"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="180" rx="72" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#4e342e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="180" rx="50" ry="7" class="metal"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="180" r="7" fill="#fff" stroke="#4e342e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="742" y="184" class="label-small">Lid</text>
  <line x1="718" y1="180" x2="732" y2="184" class="leader"/>

  <line x1="640" y1="220" x2="640" y2="390" class="rod"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="405" r="10" class="plastic"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="405" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#4e342e" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="742" y="305" class="label-small">Plunger rod</text>
  <line x1="658" y1="305" x2="732" y2="305" class="leader"/>

  <ellipse cx="640" cy="450" rx="62" ry="9" class="metal"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="450" rx="62" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="450" r="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="742" y="454" class="label-small">3a. Top cross plate</text>
  <line x1="708" y1="450" x2="732" y2="454" class="leader"/>

  <ellipse cx="640" cy="530" rx="64" ry="7" class="metal-dark"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="530" rx="64" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="530" rx="56" ry="3" class="mesh"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="530" rx="56" ry="3" class="mesh" transform="rotate(90 640 530)"/>
  <text x="742" y="534" class="label-small">3b. Mesh filter</text>
  <line x1="708" y1="530" x2="732" y2="534" class="leader"/>

  <ellipse cx="640" cy="610" rx="66" ry="9" class="metal"/>
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="610" rx="66" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="610" r="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 620 625 Q 628 630 636 625 Q 644 620 652 625 Q 660 630 668 625" fill="none" stroke="#5d4037" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="742" y="614" class="label-small">3c. Support plate + spring</text>
  <line x1="708" y1="610" x2="732" y2="614" class="leader"/>

  <text x="640" y="75" class="label-small" text-anchor="middle">Plunger assembly — exploded</text>

  <!-- ============ PARTS LIST (bottom right, fits in frame) ============ -->
  <rect x="600" y="642" width="295" height="52" class="box"/>
  <text x="615" y="658" class="label-small" font-weight="bold">Parts list</text>
  <text x="615" y="672" class="label-small">1. Carafe · 2. Lid with plunger rod & knob</text>
  <text x="615" y="686" class="label-small">3. Filter: 3a top · 3b mesh · 3c support plate + spring</text>
</svg>
